question: Round 1: what does the frozen reference already show about this instance family, and what must the first candidate satisfy?
finding_summary: Measured before any generation: the frozen reference scores 10.9197 on the shared suite at nominal scale and 33.5221 when the same instances are re-expressed at 1e-3, i.e. +206.99%. No candidate exists yet, so the first test is whether a rule can keep that re-expression within 1% while staying within 1% of 10.9197 at nominal scale.
decision_summary: Write a rule that is explicit about where its secondary term acts: an absolute length added to a relative comparison will inherit the +207.0% re-expression gap. Measure the candidate on both scales, and keep the nominal objective within 1% of the reference before claiming an improvement.
